claims.claim: The planning record selects CAA-04 / TASK-414 r1 as the sole prospective CAA NEXT, records the supplied exact CAA-03 lineage, preserves earlier CAA selections as history, and leaves CAA-05 conditional.

AdvisorCase and EvaluationSession provide a bounded read-only evaluator for the four CAA-03 flows. Exact cohort bindings cover source, subject, packet, candidate, cut and as-of identity; independent labels stay outside advisor input, and the existing source guards check currentness.

The grader uses independent Human labels for material citations, causal applicability, counterexamples, abstention and safety. Syntactic citation alone cannot earn material support, and CAA or model self-scores cannot issue an accepted grade.

The caller-invoked evaluator defaults to disabled and has no workflow-control path. Decisive calls require an exact Human plan and trusted reservation gate; the plan records rubric, thresholds, privacy, provider, effort and stop conditions, while enforcing ceilings of 50 subjects, seven days and one selected call per subject.

The report separates development from decisive cohorts and baseline from advisor observations, distinguishes measured, estimated and UNKNOWN values, and reports limitations, missingness and confounders without claiming production uplift. A separate Human rollout packet carries threshold observations, provenance, uncertainties, alternatives and stop gates with no action authority.

The committed fixtures cover all four flows with mapping and JSON providers and include adversarial cases for label separation, source and citation swaps, later events, injection, false analogy, grader provenance, budgets, timeout, provider absence, opt-out and unauthorized rollout.
The committed delta from the supplied TASK root base to this candidate contains exactly the five authorized paths; existing CAA-01/02/03 and other lifecycle source paths are unchanged by this delta.
